propositions: Canonical contributor guidance hardcodes a specific bot identity (Joe Oakhart) instead of instructing contributors to use their own configured git identity for DCO sign-off
Multiple guidance documents (AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/rebar.md, CONTRIBUTING.md) present conflicting or inconsistent instructions on whose identity must appear in the Signed-off-by field
A deterministic lint check must be integrated into make lint to detect and prevent reintroduction of hardcoded personal sign-off identities in contributor-facing documentation

Contributor-facing guidance files must be updated to require use of configured git identity while retaining bot identity references only in automation-scoped paths (infra/, .github/workflows/, tests/, docs/experiments/)
